shared_elements: schematic face/mask-like oval enclosed by a carved outline
large circular or oval eye motif set within the oval
spiral / concentric-ring motif adjacent to the face
curved grooved lines defining forms in low relief on an irregular boulder surface
repeated rounded bosses or cupule-like discs
justification: Both surfaces show the same distinctive combination of an oval, outlined face-like form containing a large ring-eye, accompanied by a spiral/concentric-circle motif set beside it, all rendered as broad grooved relief that exploits the natural swelling of the boulder — a fairly specific and non-obvious scheme. The main difference is that A presents a crowded multi-figure composition including an apparently anthropomorphic body with arms and hands and several repeated masks, while B shows only a single isolated face with one accompanying spiral and no bodily elements.
